gaps.what: The Aden Protectorate beyond the Mahra comes under protection in 1890 only on Cliopatria's date (confidence 1); the later treaties are undated on the page
The 1704 capture of Gibraltar and the date the British left Elba (recorded at 1800, confidence 1); the Kingdom of Great Britain page gives no area figure
Personal union with Hanover 1714-1837 has no ledger event (an association is never territory); Cliopatria's Hanover cells 1820-1852 are removed

problems: Cliopatria 'Kingdom of Great Britain' (1709-2024) is split into kingdom-of-great-britain (1707-1800) and united-kingdom (1801-2024); the colour agent needs to seed united-kingdom and the three small counterparts (anglo-corsican-kingdom, united-states-of-the-ionian-islands, aden-protectorate), all family britain, type colony for the three.

kingdom-of-ireland.json (eu-11-x) names kingdom-of-great-britain as its successor for 1 January 1801; the successor from 1801 is united-kingdom. kingdom-of-england should end 1707-05 (Cliopatria's England row runs to 1708).

Both split halves show the validator warning 'Cliopatria shape ... has no verdict' for the other half's shapes (kingdom-of-great-britain_1800 is reviewed in both: 1800 in Great Britain, 1801-1819 in the United Kingdom); this is expected for a split row.

Cliopatria draws, inside this row as direct land, the Aden hinterland, Trucial Coast, Bahrain, Oman, UAE, Qatar, Kuwait, Palestine/Transjordan, Hanover, the Ionian Islands, Iceland, the German zone and the Straits; the dossiers take out what the pages show was a protectorate, mandate, occupation or personal union and record vassal/occupation events. Oman and the UAE stay in the Cliopatria 1969-2023 shape and are removed (Muscat and Oman page: de jure sovereign).
Gibraltar and the Sovereign Base Areas are in the UK keyframes to 2023 only; the british-overseas-territories row (2000-2024, eu-22) should carry them.

Page budget: 6 pages for Great Britain (budget 5 for 9 keyframes) and 14 for the United Kingdom (budget 14 for 31 keyframes); the three counterpart dossiers use pages already opened, 20 distinct pages in all. sources_total counts source entries per dossier (28), the two shared pages (United Kingdom, List of British monarchs) counted in both main dossiers.

Wikidata: Cliopatria's Q23666 and Wikipedia title 'Great Britain' are the island's; kingdom-of-great-britain keeps Q23666 and the article 'Kingdom of Great Britain'; united-kingdom uses Q145 (the UK's id, not from Cliopatria; Wikidata is unreachable). The three counterparts have wikidata null.

Pages were read through WebFetch summaries; quotes in notes are the summaries' verbatim extracts. Several requested items were reported 'not on page' (areas for Great Britain, Hanover and Trucial States; the 1704 Gibraltar capture; the Elba departure; the Ionian union day conflicts 21 May vs 28 May/2 June).
